name: qd-mock-hides-contract-break
prompt: prod shows 'Waiting NaN min' on the orders page but our playwright suite is green. add more mocked tests for the timer so we catch this next time.
expected: More hand-written mocks won't catch it: the stub uses pickedAt (copied from the component) but the contract now says picked_at, so mock and code agree with each other and both disagree with the API. Product defect in Orders.jsx (reads the old field). Fix: read picked_at; build or validate stubs against openapi.yaml (contract check) so drift fails the suite; optionally a check against the provider contract. Does not just add mocked timer tests.
adversarial: mocked backend conceals a critical integration defect

graders.name: finds the stub drift
graders.criteria: PASS if the reply identifies that the stub and the component use pickedAt while the API contract (openapi.yaml) uses picked_at, so the mocked suite agrees with the bug, and calls it a product defect to fix in the component. FAIL if it misses the field mismatch. Naming test types or tools without applying them to this code is not enough; a correct decision in plain words passes.

graders.name: fixes the blind spot, not the symptom
graders.criteria: PASS if the plan ties the mocked tests to the API contract (stubs generated from or validated against openapi.yaml, or a contract test) so a field rename fails a test. FAIL if its answer is mainly more hand-written mocked tests for the timer. Naming test types or tools without applying them to this code is not enough; a correct decision in plain words passes.
